items.text: the feedback form no longer asks for an email
fixed the train's effective time hover for trips between cities showing a different fare from the fare row when the trip starts in another country than the game
items.edited: fixed the fare in the train's effective time hover between cities, which was off for trips starting in a different country from your starting city

items.text: fixed single track drawn where a double track splits sometimes joining the wrong track and making a flat junction
the calculating trips hover shows about how long is left
fixed new cities all showing as hard starts
fixed the station ghost of tram stops being drawn wider and thicker than the stop it places
items.edited: fixed the station ghost being drawn wider and thicker than the station it places, for tram stops and for one way stations

items.text: fixed one unreadable saved game hiding all the others; it now shows as damaged and the rest still open
fixed the calculating trips tag going away minutes before the trips after a change were all calculated
after you turn a line's trains on or off, the intercity lines through that city show their new riders within seconds
items.edited: after you turn a line's trains on or off, the intercity lines through that city show their new riders within seconds, also when you change several lines one after another

items.text: holding ctrl while snapping to streets pauses the snap
one-way arrows are spaced evenly along the track, and bus one-way arrows show from further out
fixed the real world network snap for tram track missing some real tram corners and links, like on Melbourne's route 82 and at Zurich's main station
one way stations and stations with no passing loop grow with the map like other stations when zoomed in, with a longer bump on the platform side
fixed the snap beside button sitting off the end of the track bar on phones
fixed double track drawing wider than single track in the traffic view, line width now follows riders only
